problem: The daily report arrives made — and anyone can copy it across
action: At the office counter. A young staff member in a plain shirt stands copying figures into the open register with a pen, concentrating on the page. The dealer stands beside him, relaxed, one hand resting on the counter, not supervising — just present. He is not doing the work and does not need to.
lighting: Bright even morning light through the office glass, clean and unfussy, both men well lit.
camera: Waist-up two-shot, the staff member on the left in profile writing, the dealer on the right facing slightly towards camera. Both sharp. The open register sits in the lower third. 35mm.
detail: The register pages carry faint ruling only — NO legible writing, NO words, NO numbers, NO letters. The staff member's shirt has NO logo, NO badge, NO uniform. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: The most valuable idea in the whole offer: the work leaves his hands and it does not have to be him who does it.
motion: The staff member's pen hand moves slowly along a line. The dealer glances at the page and then away, unworried. A slow push in. No cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: डी-एस-आर रोज़ बनकर आपके फ़ोन पर। कोई भी उतार ले — आपको बैठना नहीं पड़ेगा।
